title: rudbeckia serotina f. frondosa
intro: Rudbeckia serotina f. frondosa, commonly known as Prairie Coneflower, is a flowering plant species native to North America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, helping to soothe skin irritations, wounds, and infections. The therapeutic actions of Prairie Coneflower include promoting wound healing, reducing fever, and alleviating digestive issues due to its bioactive constituents. The bioactive constituents of Rudbeckia serotina f. frondosa include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
